title: Gradient Spillover
tagline: Compare how different quantization regimes reshape compute cost in distributed gradient aggregation.

curves.label: Top-K Sparse Gradients
curves.code: K = Math.floor(0.05*paramCount); nnz = K*n; cost = nnz*Math.log2(n) + 0.02*n*n
curves.name: Top-K Sparse Gradients

curves.label: 4-bit Stochastic Rounding
curves.code: qbytes = 0.5*paramCount*n; steps = Math.ceil(Math.log2(n)); varianceOverhead = Math.log2(n)*n*n/100; cost = qbytes*steps/(n) + varianceOverhead + 0.4*n
curves.name: 4-bit Stochastic Rounding
